response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.throws AS throws, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), s AS (SELECT throws, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM a)) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM a)
